d: We are seeking an experienced and qualified IT Specialist to join our team.

The successful candidate will be responsible for managing, maintaining, and supporting the company's IT infrastructure across all branches, ensuring reliable, secure, and efficient IT operations. The role involves providing technical support to employees across all company locations, maintaining network systems, troubleshooting technical issues, and ensuring smooth IT operations throughout the organization.
q: Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related field.
Minimum of 5 years of professional experience in IT support and administration.
Strong knowledge of computer systems, networks, hardware, software, and troubleshooting.
Ability to provide technical support across all company branches.
Excellent problem-solving, communication, and organizational skills.
r: li
